integrity: One proposed theorem with pressure/work/shape corollaries. Analytical stationarity and uniqueness proof supplied; exact-rational generator verification plus finite Monte Carlo provided; same-model review only and no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact for athermal positive-rate Poisson full redraws among 2d cardinal headings, hard rectangular clipping and independent particles. Does not apply to spherical heading distribution, finite wall softness, thermal diffusion, wall-induced reorientation, or interacting gas. The exact quasistatic work potential is not a statement of zero entropy production.
title: A product-form stationary law and exact shape optimum for cardinal-heading active particles in rectangular boxes
